questions.question: Which organism is responsible for producing the largest proportion of Earth's oxygen?
questions.hint: Microscopic marine phytoplankton produce roughly half of Earth's oxygen through photosynthesis, making them among the planet's most important organisms.

questions.question: Which animal has the highest recorded lifespan of any known vertebrate?
questions.hint: Greenland sharks can live for at least 250 years, with some estimates suggesting individuals may exceed 400 years.

questions.question: Which film holds the record for the most Academy Award wins?
options: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
questions.hint: Each of these films has won 11 Academy Awards, tying the all-time record.

questions.question: Which fictional detective was created by Agatha Christie?
questions.hint: Belgian detective Hercule Poirot appears in 33 novels, over 50 short stories, and numerous adaptations.

questions.question: Which international organization coordinates the global postal system?
questions.hint: The Universal Postal Union, founded in 1874, standardizes international mail services.

questions.question: Which international organization establishes standards for global telecommunications?
questions.hint: The International Telecommunication Union coordinates radio spectrum, satellite orbits, and communication standards.

questions.question: Which civilization invented concrete that has survived for nearly 2,000 years?
questions.hint: Roman concrete contains volcanic ash, allowing many ancient structures to remain remarkably durable.

questions.question: Which battle marked the final defeat of Napoleon Bonaparte?
questions.hint: Napoleon was defeated at the Battle of Waterloo in 1815, ending his rule permanently.

questions.question: Which athlete holds the men's world record in the 100-meter sprint?
questions.hint: Usain Bolt's 9.58-second world record was set in Berlin in 2009.

questions.question: Which country has won the most ICC Men's Cricket World Cup titles?
questions.hint: Australia has won six ICC Men's Cricket World Cup championships.

questions.question: Which country has the longest continuous land border with another country?
questions.hint: The Canada–United States border stretches approximately 8,891 kilometers (5,525 miles).

questions.question: Which desert is the largest in the world?
questions.hint: A desert is defined by low precipitation, making Antarctica the world's largest desert.

questions.question: Which physicist developed the equations describing electromagnetism?
questions.hint: Maxwell's equations unified electricity, magnetism, and light into a single theory.

questions.question: Which particle discovered in 2012 completed the Standard Model of particle physics?
questions.hint: The Higgs Boson was discovered at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012.

questions.question: Which civilization built the city of Chichén Itzá?
questions.hint: Chichén Itzá became one of the most influential cities of the Maya civilization.

questions.question: Which language has the largest number of native speakers in the world?
questions.hint: Mandarin Chinese has the highest number of native speakers worldwide.

questions.question: Which mammal is capable of echolocation?
questions.hint: Bats navigate and hunt using echolocation by emitting high-frequency sounds and interpreting returning echoes.

questions.question: Which country spans the greatest number of time zones (including overseas territories)?
questions.hint: Including its overseas territories, France spans 12 official time zones, more than any other country.

questions.question: Which branch of mathematics studies change and motion through derivatives and integrals?
questions.hint: Calculus, independently developed by Isaac Newton and Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, forms the foundation of modern science and engineering.

questions.question: Which civilization built the ancient city of Teotihuacan, one of the largest cities in the pre-Columbian Americas?
questions.hint: Although later revered by the Aztecs, the original builders of Teotihuacan are still unknown, making it one of archaeology's greatest mysteries.
